plain.li: [greetings,warm,their:hunters] Your letter was read at the lantern post tonight, {WRITER}. The colony has a good page in our book, and it stays open.
[greetings,cordial,their:hunters] The lodge has your letter, {WRITER}. If a beast comes onto your land, a Warden will hear of it.
[greetings,cool,their:hunters] We have your letter. The book will say what kind of neighbour you are, in time.
[news,warm,their:hunters] Every lodge hears where the beasts are moving, {WRITER}, and where people are. Here is what the lanterns tell us this season.
[news,cordial,their:hunters] Our trackers see the roads before anyone. This is what they saw.
[help,warm,their:hunters] What you asked for is coming with a lantern-runner, {WRITER}. The Wardens keep what they promise until it is done.
[help,cordial,their:hunters] The lodge can spare it, and it is on the road with our runner.
[help,refusal,their:hunters] The lodge has three lanterns lit on its roads this season, {WRITER}, and nothing left to send. We are sorry for it.
[invitation,warm,their:hunters] A Warden will come, and keep a lantern lit at your gate while they stay.
[condolences,warm,their:hunters] We have lit a lantern at the lodge for your dead, {WRITER}, and it burns tonight beside our own.
[condolences,cordial,their:hunters] The Wardens are sorry for your loss, {WRITER}. Where a lantern burns, someone was taken, and we have lit one.
[warning,warm,their:hunters] Your warning reached the lodge before the trouble did, {WRITER}. The trackers are in and the gate is barred, and the book will remember who told us.
[warning,cordial,their:hunters] We have your warning, {WRITER}. The lanterns on the roads will burn all night.
[greetings,warm,their:sextons] Your letter was read aloud in the grave-garden at evening, {WRITER}, and the first bell rang once for your colony's health.
[greetings,cordial,their:sextons] The Bell has your letter, {WRITER}, and keeps it with the others, quietly.
[greetings,cool,their:sextons] We have your letter. The Bell rings for everyone, in the end.
[news,warm,their:sextons] The dead come to us from every road, {WRITER}, and so does the news of how they died. Here is what the grave-gardens heard.
[news,cordial,their:sextons] The ground hears a great deal, and so do those who dig it. This is the season's word.
[help,warm,their:sextons] The Bell has little, but what it has is given. What you asked for is coming with a bell-carrier.
[help,cordial,their:sextons] We can spare it, quietly, and it is on the road.
[help,refusal,their:sextons] The grave-gardens are full this season, {WRITER}, and everything we have goes into the ground. There is nothing to send.
[invitation,warm,their:sextons] A bell-keeper will come, and say a word at your gate for the living.
[condolences,warm,their:sextons] We rang for your dead this evening, {WRITER}, once each, as for our own. Everyone is owed a bell.
[condolences,cordial,their:sextons] The Bell is sorry for your loss, {WRITER}. The ground keeps what it is given, gently.
[warning,warm,their:sextons] Your warning came in time, {WRITER}. The grave-gardens are shut and the bell is ready, and the Bell owes you more than a letter.
[warning,cordial,their:sextons] We have your warning, {WRITER}. We will listen to the ground tonight.
[greetings,warm,their:tamers] Your letter got read out at the ring tonight, {WRITER}, between bouts, and everybody cheered.
[greetings,cordial,their:tamers] The Circuit has your letter, {WRITER}. Any tamer on the road will stop by and say hello.
[greetings,cool,their:tamers] We have your letter. Come and meet us in the ring sometime, and we will see.
[news,warm,their:tamers] Tamers walk every road in the region, {WRITER}, and talk at every ring. Here is the best of what they brought in.
[news,cordial,their:tamers] The rings hear everything, mostly between bouts. This is what they heard.
[help,warm,their:tamers] Of course, {WRITER}, and gladly. What you asked for is coming with a beast-rider.
[help,cordial,their:tamers] The ring can spare it, and a rider is bringing it.
[help,refusal,their:tamers] The stables ate everything we had this season, {WRITER}, and then asked for more. We have nothing to send.
[invitation,warm,their:tamers] A tamer will come, and bring a companion who wants to meet yours.
[condolences,warm,their:tamers] We tied a black token on every sash at the ring for your dead, {WRITER}, and our beasts stood quiet for them.
[condolences,cordial,their:tamers] The Circuit is sorry for your loss, {WRITER}. Win their trust and they will win your battles, and your dead won many.
[warning,warm,their:tamers] Your warning came in time, {WRITER}. The stables are shut and the beasts are in, and the Circuit owes you a bout and more.
[warning,cordial,their:tamers] We have your warning, {WRITER}. The rangers will bring everyone in tonight.
[greetings,warm,their:salvagers] Your letter caught up with the Wheel two stops on, {WRITER}, and the whole yard read it over supper.
[greetings,cordial,their:salvagers] The Wheel has your letter, {WRITER}. Next time we come round, we will stop.
[greetings,cool,their:salvagers] We have your letter. Trade with us once, and we will talk properly.
[news,warm,their:salvagers] The Wheel sees the whole region every few years, {WRITER}, and buys its rubbish. Here is what the rubbish says.
[news,cordial,their:salvagers] Every stop has gossip, and we pick it up with the scrap. This is the season's.
[help,warm,their:salvagers] Nothing is broken, only waiting, {WRITER}, and what you need is coming with a scrap-runner.
[help,cordial,their:salvagers] Call it a loan against the next swap, and it is on its way.
[help,refusal,their:salvagers] The Wheel is stuck on a broken axle this season, {WRITER}, and everything we have is holding it together. We have nothing to send.
[invitation,warm,their:salvagers] A fixer will come, with tools, and mend whatever you leave lying about.
[condolences,warm,their:salvagers] The Wheel stopped for a whole hour for your dead, {WRITER}, which it never does. We are sorry.
[condolences,cordial,their:salvagers] The Wheel is sorry for your loss, {WRITER}. We carry our own dead with us until the next good ground, and we know what it costs.
[warning,warm,their:salvagers] Your warning caught the Wheel before the trouble did, {WRITER}, and we turned in time. We owe you, and the Wheel pays its debts.
[warning,cordial,their:salvagers] We have your warning, {WRITER}. The yard will be rolling by morning.
[arrive,their:hunters] Word from the lodge, and the roads are clear behind me.
[leave,their:hunters] My lantern needs filling before dark, so I'll be off.
[deliver,their:hunters] From the lodge, and counted twice like a pelt.
[arrive,their:sextons] Peace on the living here, I bring the Bell's word.
[leave,their:sextons] The bell rings at evening, and I should be there.
[deliver,their:sextons] From the grave-garden, given quietly.
[arrive,their:tamers] Hello from the ring, and my beast says hello too.
[leave,their:tamers] Off to the next ring, there's a bout I can't miss.
[deliver,their:tamers] From the Circuit, with a token for luck.
[arrive,their:salvagers] Message from the yard, and the Wheel's two stops on already.
[leave,their:salvagers] Got to catch the Wheel before it rolls again.
[collect,their:salvagers] The yard will make good use of this, nothing wasted.
[arrive,their:hunters] Any beasts about, or is it quiet here?
[wait,their:hunters] I've waited longer in a cold blind, take your time.
[stay,their:hunters] A roof over the lantern for once, that's a kindness.
[leave,their:hunters] Keep it lit until it is done, and send word if anything comes.
[pass,their:hunters] Every page of the book gets its ending, sooner or later.
[arrive,their:sextons] Peace on the living here.
[wait,their:sextons] The dead are patient, so I can be too.
[stay,their:sextons] A quiet house, I like it.
[leave,their:sextons] Ring once for friend and foe alike, and you'll sleep well.
[pass,their:sextons] The ground keeps what it is given, so give it gently.
[arrive,their:tamers] Nice place, do you keep any beasts?
[wait,their:tamers] My companion's fine waiting, it's me that gets restless.
[stay,their:tamers] A good stable, I can tell from here.
[leave,their:tamers] Next time, a bout, and I won't take no for an answer.
[pass,their:tamers] A bond is not a leash, remember that with yours.
[arrive,their:salvagers] Anything broken round here, or anything for sale?
[wait,their:salvagers] No hurry, the Wheel's slow on the hills.
[stay,their:salvagers] A floor that doesn't roll, I'd forgotten what that's like.
[leave,their:salvagers] We leave tomorrow, we always leave tomorrow.
[pass,their:salvagers] Nothing is broken, only waiting.
[chat,them,their:hunters] A beast that takes a person answers for it, that's the whole of what we do.
[endwarm,them,their:hunters] If a beast ever comes for yours, light a lantern at the crossroads and we'll see it.
[faithtalk,them,their:hunters] Garrow kept his brother's lantern lit eleven years, and we keep ours until it's done.
[chat,them,their:sextons] Everyone is owed a bell, even the ones nobody liked.
[endwarm,them,their:sextons] When your time comes, the Bell will ring for you, I promise.
[faithtalk,them,their:sextons] Ysolde Marr rang a cracked bell over every grave in the long field, and we ring it still.
[chat,them,their:tamers] Win their trust and they will win your battles, it's that simple.
[endwarm,them,their:tamers] Come to the ring sometime, I'd love to lose to you.
[faithtalk,them,their:tamers] Pell walked forty years with what hatched from a star's egg, and every bond is hers.
[chat,them,their:salvagers] Buy it cheap, sell it better, and never stop moving.
[endwarm,them,their:salvagers] When the Wheel comes round again, I'll save you the good scrap.
[faithtalk,them,their:salvagers] Wainwright drove out ahead of the fire, and nobody has voted to stop since.
Quiet now, you are home.
Everyone is owed a bell, and this one is yours.
The ground keeps what it is given, so we give it gently.
Ring once, and let them go.
We will remember the good of them out loud, now.
Nobody is buried alone while the Bell is there.
I keep thinking they'll walk in from the fields.
Bury them deep, and listen, and then go home and live.

gloomy.li: It was too soon, whatever the bell says.

warm.li: They would have laughed at all of us standing here so solemn.

plain.li: [opt0] I went after {BEAST} with the Lantern Wardens today. They move like people who have done it a hundred times, because they have.
[opt0] The Wardens keep a book of every beast they've run down. {BEAST} had a page in it before any of us knew its name.
[opt1] Wardens came for {BEAST} and we let them hunt it alone. I watched from the wall with my heart going.
[opt2] Wardens came to hunt {BEAST} on our land and we sent them away. I hope that was right.

cold.li: [opt0] A hunt is a hunt. They know theirs.

plain.li: [opt0] A Warden lit a lantern at the gate for {DEAD} and we stood the first night of it together. It will burn until {BEAST} is dead, the Warden says.
[opt1] There's a lantern at our gate now for {DEAD}. I keep looking at it.
[opt2] A Warden wanted to light a lantern for {DEAD}. I couldn't bear it, not yet.

warm.li: [opt0] A stranger came all that way to keep a light burning for {DEAD}. I didn't know people still did that.

plain.li: [opt0] A bell-keeper of the Quiet Bell led {DEAD}'s funeral today, and said the Bell's words at the end. I don't think I breathed until it was quiet again.
[opt1] I stood at {DEAD}'s grave with a bell-keeper while the bell was rung. Just the two of us and one note.
[opt2] The Quiet Bell came for {DEAD}'s funeral and we wanted it to be ours. They understood.

gloomy.li: [opt0] One bell, and then quiet, and then everyone went back to work.

plain.li: [opt0] A tamer of the Circuit challenged me to a bout with {BEAST}. Whatever happened after, I'll remember the look on its face when I squared up.
[opt0] The Circuit say a bond is not a leash. Watching {X_nameDef} with {BEAST}, I believe them.
[opt1] I sat with a tamer while {BEAST} showed off everything it knew. Some of it I'm going to try on ours.
[opt2] A tamer wanted a bout and we said not today. {X_nameDef} laughed and said the challenge stands.

cheerful.li: [opt0] Best fun I've had in a season, win or lose.
